notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE v1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello streamers, We are very happy to publish the new update we have prepared for Streamer life simulator. I hope you enjoy the newly added features to the game. This update also resolves many critical bugs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/a0fa07f95b9c68fd58b70e255dcbe92a8250184e.jpg[/img]
First, new cars have been added to the game. You can go to the car location and buy new cars.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/a949f11e0cd19395bbf4d2c45db9b507d78a551a.jpg[/img]
You can use the maps app to see where the cars are sold.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/b28812de3a43366edef2d09a073b6a38cf2a81b4.jpg[/img]
Skill system has been added to the game. With the experience you get by streaming, you can unlock new abilities for your character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/15bd46b2c0f75e4420af81a910ee3175a01115ef.jpg[/img]
ASMR stream option added to ops
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/7f38c5bc0fcda9b4dd141b17a25e21e14da087b7.jpg[/img]
CREATIVE stream option added to ops
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/6c72739a5529eae5a6cfe371103d7ed6db36a8dd.jpg[/img]
And new mini games have been added to the game
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/9ef05d9c830a819e887ff223338ddd8422b1c215.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/76ece27e65702766cc4315fa3240cec397101da9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/d529eccf18de43b90e229a7dca38c4d0bd5f793a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/0eb6329a391139afe6f017b5983ce2835539f7c8.jpg[/img]

*Quit job option has been added to the Jobking website.
*The light problem in the apartment has been solved
*A bug with Crypto prices has been fixed
*The bugs related to dogs not being able to enter houses have been fixed.
*Fixed the issue where some items were entered to the bottom of the ground.
*Fixed the issue where the ordered products are different when opening the box.
*Optimization work was carried out in the Suburban neighborhood.
*Cats added to the pet shop page
*Fixed an error that occurred when playing horse racing bets.
*A critical bug that prevented you from interacting with objects in the later stages of the game has been 
fixed.
*An error that occurred when the joystick was attached to the computer has been fixed.
*Mini games that caused some display errors have been fixed.
*Fixed some audio errors caused by surrounding cars.
Discord: https://discord.gg/Fue8XtE

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.53
notes.notes:
Fixed the error when placing the wall mounted TV.
Fixed a bug that triggered you to get out of the car when it rolled over.
The bug that the stream continues when you sleep with the stream on has disappeared.
The rate of appearing selection cards has been reduced when playing mini games!
Fixed bug where the Miner device was out of sync with game sound volume.
Fixed a bug that prevented some items purchased through Zamazor from unboxing.
Bugs that occurred when purchasing a console have been fixed.

notes.title: Update v1.0.5

notes.title: Dev Update 6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are in the 6th part of our article that we share with you the new features we have added to our game. If you have nice ideas that you want added to the game, you can contact us by mail. Or you can join our steam chat group. We actively talk about the game here. You can write the feature you want in the game here.
Steam chat link - https://s.team/chat/aVCgsz79
Mail: zappzappinfo@gmail.com
Since there is very little time left for the release of our game, we generally focus on balancing and error resolution. There are only new features added here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/f4efb6261041c00a6d47c532dd773bb190cad42e.png[/img]
You can now take out a loan from the bank. You can set a payment schedule as you wish.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/28a858fdbe2d6b73651824442bb4203497c482ff.png[/img]
A shop where you can buy pets has been added. You can adopt any kind of dog you want. You have to take care of your pet's food and health. You can buy food online or buy it from a pet store.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/558c5b544fbdd42975264f9f1e89f8f6381a4148.png[/img]
Tired of old equipment or chair? Here they are a man who can buy from you. A man who bought second hand items has been added to the game. You can bargaining with this man while selling your stuff. But you have to be careful not to get too angry.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/19b7fde3e39315e7f63dbc9fc1461d6b80a8813f.png[/img]
You can scramble trash to earn additional income. Sometimes you can find a few useful items that can be sold.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/0e464e71b3c86932c21d91fd7766e2a587358708.png[/img]
We have added a new mini game that can be played to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/69c7454850e9769cca5f6b4b0cc6129bb7e1eb9c.png[/img]
The beginning scene and a small dialogue have been added to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/39dead22e6bb1127599ade1dfd1bd8f9847ff6a6.png[/img]
Starting missions have been added to the game to help you adapt to the game and learn a few basic mechanics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/9c21f7357940ce93d233effc80706d0fec82400b.png[/img]
We have added a feedback system to the game in order to receive feedback from everyone playing the game and to improve the game in line with your wishes and to solve the bugs found.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/3423966224902ec49d4f8307791782bc8e76aa29.png[/img]
Steam achievements have been added to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/5c8887529c952bf222c7bde0b7b837dfca9fcb17.png[/img]
A small helper application has been added to the game that can show the days you stream and the days you did not open stream.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/cd223448dee6e8b1353a36487dab86ad2b77a16a.png[/img]
Tutorials explaining some of the game mechanics have been added to the game as a folder.
Thank you for reading the update notes.

notes.title: Dev Update 5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are in the 5th part of our article that we share with you the new features we have added to our game. If you have nice ideas that you want added to the game, you can contact us by mail. Or you can join our steam chat group. We actively talk about the game here. You can write the feature you want in the game here.
Steam chat link - https://s.team/chat/aVCgsz79
Mail: zappzappinfo@gmail.com
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/064058aac46eb8377a8abad523cdf094b5191904.png[/img]
We worked on the lighting system, reflections and shadows of the game, and generally worked on the post processing side.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/1543e878aa8ad1c42206b4d0442941bf1cc5c76c.png[/img]
We added a view from the city that will take place in the game and the roads that will connect the city with other regions. We have added some pedestrians traveling in the city and in different regions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/b4b4adb7e8870c3a7d1e25b34b7844c0715c2fb9.png[/img]
If your computer gets too infected, the computer can be hacked. You can prevent this by fighting hack, but we didn't add it here to avoid spoilers. You can even rob the person trying to rob you by hacking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/f4390e43d42dc48a71e9e19b30f6edf4d81d29ea.png[/img]
We have added a maps application to the phone. You can open the map in the game in this way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/3a14fc5191533083d0c38f55c0114596af2790d0.png[/img]
We have added new houses in different places that you can buy in the game. You can buy houses on a website. The internet infrastructure of each house is different.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/f4fdef6e9ec7a22ff2a625583fbdc81db153d56f.png[/img]
With the Maps application, you can open a navigation on your screen for the place you want.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/ce7044d77b8daa23dcf45671af3256a1c2a0a99e.png[/img]
You can allocate a budget to advertise the channel you are streaming and attract more viewers. If you want, you can make your channel appear on the billboards by placing physical advertising or you can organize an online advertising campaign.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/1d455f351cb55397d026baab3bb5edc48252a1f2.png[/img]
Added some npc vehicles traveling on the roads in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/4831bf9cd1f84e1718715c9ff38f50e7542662d0.png[/img]
We have added a music application that you can use while streaming or at different times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/351f2de3ab5a7a6eb753110004157c1e48d8b308.png[/img]
We have added a website where you can pay your bills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/9ce2fd7bb0395236aa2ccba66dbc87130e138d01.png[/img]
We have added a game that you can play. You can have rank in the game or even use cheat. Be careful, you can ban. As your rank increases, you may encounter stronger opponents. And the FPS you get in the game depends on your computer in the game. And it really affects gameplay. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/056406ff111759a005a3ffdc2c9b0e927dfeb58f.png[/img]
We have added a website where you can participate in tournaments.

notes.title: Dev Update 4

notes.title: Dev Update 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are here with our 2nd announcement.
There are several features that are liked in the internet cafe simulator. We have added these features to this game. We developed the system a little more and added different features.
You can see them in the rest of the notes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/3970ea7b75a708e9ccf6929c6798a9d5f8fb00a1.png[/img]
We have added a website where you can order food.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/03476b9675fc507f73c0d8463203fe0a46876b3b.png[/img]
a website where you can test your internet speed. The most important thing in the game is the internet speed. To access very high internet speeds, you may need to move the infrastructure to a decent house. From a website we will add in the future, you will be able to see the maximum internet packages valid for your home.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/1d6ab434288601e0d9f205003f7130a333d24b24.png[/img]
Shopping site where you can buy from computer parts to household goods. Moreover, we added basket feature. You can buy your items in bulk.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/bf042b5d28630abe11ac93f19818e3f7299254dc.png[/img]
A website where you can open a skin safe.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/fc884be9aca251d6c1fb8f2c5a770a75483ac146.png[/img]
You can see and change all the parts of the computer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/2967ecab52355fc6a5c3d66b3f252897a61c1577.png[/img]
An application where you can see all the hardware connected to your computer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36979857/3ebaf8bd9ea7360dc851c0131b443ba142417be8.png[/img]
Scratch & Win
--
Thank you for reading. If you have ideas for the game, you can send us by mail. Or you can leave it here as a comment. Thanks to everyone who contributed to the development of the game.

notes.title: Dev Update 1
notes.notes:
Hello, we would like to tell you about some of the features we added.

You have a bag that starts from 4 slots but can expand to 8 slots
